title: Momentum Stories and Micro-Asks Journal
body:
Purpose
- Short running journal to capture 2–3 minute impact stories for weekly 1:1s and my quarterly review. Keep entries tiny so I actually update them. Each entry ends with a single micro-ask (one specific, small ask for my manager or org).

Format I use (one line title, 2–4 lines context, metric or outcome, micro-ask):

1) Faster new-hire ramp (Feb retrospective)
- What: Piloted a lean onboarding checklist for infra SRE hires; cut first-week setup calls by consolidating credentials + infra diagram into a single doc + short walkthrough video.
- Outcome: Two recent hires completed first oncall shadow and ran a safe rollback by day 6; anecdotal slack feedback: "much clearer" and fewer follow-ups.
- Metrics: first-week ticket volume dropped ~40% for onboarding-related issues (sample n=4).
- Micro-ask: Can you share this with Eng Hiring leads and ask for a 1-page adoption note? (1 action: post in #eng-hiring)

2) Eviction policy clarity for Dedicated customers (Feb 26)
- What: Wrote a draft FAQ to clarify reserved capacity eviction fallbacks and billing for burst usage; pulled examples from two customer incidents.
- Outcome: Product asked to adopt the FAQ text for support playbook; reduced back-and-forth on billing policy.
- Metric: Expected ~30% reduction in support escalations on billing/tier confusion for next sprint.
- Micro-ask: Please prioritize a short review with Product (CC: Priya) this week so we can ship to support docs.

3) Small wins: cross-team troubleshooting pattern (Mar 3)
- What: Led a 20-min async triage with infra+serving-runtime to isolate a perf regression to a kernel selection change. Collated trace snippets and a minimal repro.
- Outcome: Rollback + targeted CI check implemented; rollback avoided a 15% latency spike during peak.
- Metric: Latency regression prevented, estimated $3.5k/day in cost avoidance in worst-case.
- Micro-ask: Ask SRE manager for 1 hour of retro time to turn the repro into a short runbook.

Quick evidence ledger (tiny table I paste in 1:1):
- Feb 4: onboarding checklist v0.3 (link: CONFLUENCE-1234) — hires: Nora, Ben — notes: fewer followups
- Feb 26: eviction-faq-draft (doc link) — used in support triage — PR: github.com/redwood/ops-docs/pull/421
- Mar 3: perf-trace.zip (GDrive) — rollback in canary cluster — incident ref: JIRA-OPS-876

Open questions / decisions I want manager input on:
- Prioritization: I can convert the onboarding checklist into a templated Notion page for hiring, but it will take ~6–8 hours. Should I defer to sprint work or push for adoption now?
- Delegation: Who should own the eviction-faq living doc? Product PM or Support docs? I lean Support as operational owner but Product must sign off on wording.
- Visibility: How much of the perf-trace story should I include in the quarterly update to highlight cross-team reliability work? (short version + link?)

Weekly micro-ask batch (copy/paste-ready for 1:1)
- Share onboarding checklist with Eng Hiring leads (post in #eng-hiring).
- Quick review with Priya on eviction FAQ (15–20 minutes).
- 1 hour retro with SRE to bake repro into runbook.

Snippets to drop into manager message (tone: concise, action-oriented)
- "Small wins: onboarding checklist pilot reduced first-week onboarding tickets by ~40% (n=4). Can I ask you to share this with hiring leads so we can scale?"
- "Eviction FAQ ready for product review — one quick look from Priya and I can hand to Support for publishing."
- "Caught a kernel-selection perf regression in canary; rollback and CI guard put in place. Recommend a short retro to convert repro into a runbook."

Personal reflection (2 lines):
- I feel momentum when I can move an item from doc -> action -> adoption within two weeks. Need to reduce the friction on getting cross-team signoff.
- Energy check: 70% capacity this sprint; prefer focused work on onboarding templates rather than a wide-scoped project.

Logistics / quick links I keep handy:
- Onboarding checklist doc: CONFLUENCE-1234
- Eviction FAQ draft: google-drive://eviction-faq-draft (will paste link)
- Incident ticket: JIRA-OPS-876
- PR for docs: github.com/redwood/ops-docs/pull/421

Tiny TODOs (2-minute items)
- Add Priya to eviction-faq doc (done?) — check collaborators list\- Post onboarding checklist to #eng-hiring (copy prepared)\- Slack Priya with 2 time options for review

Last edited notes: keep entries constrained to 3 impact stories max per week. If I add more, they become noise and I stop updating.

-- laney
